0. FOREWORD
0.1 This index has been prepared at the request of manufacturers and users of iron and steel to help them in easily locating the terms defined in various parts of IS : 1956 as given below: IS : 1956 ( Part I)-1976 IS : 1956 ( Part II )-I976 IS : 1956 ( Part III)-1975 IS : 1956 ( Part IV)-1975 IS : 1956 (Part V)-1976 IS : 1956 ( Part VI)-1976 IS : 1956 ( Part VII)-1976 IS : 1956 ( Part VIII )-1976 Glossary of terms relating to iron and steel: Part metallurgy, heat treatment and testing Glossary making of terms relating to iron I General II Steel

and steel: Part
